tools.image-denoise.metadata.description: Free online tool to remove noise and grain from photos. Median filter algorithm with adjustable strength, processed entirely in your browser — private and secure.
tools.image-denoise.title: Image Denoise
tools.image-denoise.description: Automatically remove noise, grain, and compression artifacts from photos for a cleaner, sharper image. Uses a median filter algorithm that preserves edge detail well while denoising. All processing happens locally in your browser — your photos are never uploaded.
tools.image-denoise.faqs.0.question: How does denoising work?
tools.image-denoise.faqs.0.answer: The tool uses a median filter algorithm: for each pixel, it takes the median value of its surrounding neighborhood as the new value. This effectively removes random noise and salt-and-pepper noise while preserving edges better than a mean blur.
tools.image-denoise.faqs.1.question: What is noise?
tools.image-denoise.faqs.1.answer: Noise is the randomly distributed grain or colored speckles in a photo, usually caused by high ISO, low-light conditions, or JPEG compression. Denoising can dramatically improve the quality of such photos.
tools.image-denoise.faqs.2.question: Will denoising make my image blurry?
tools.image-denoise.faqs.2.answer: A median filter preserves edges better than blur-based algorithms, but overly strong denoising can still lose some detail. Start with a small radius and increase it gradually if you are not satisfied.
tools.image-denoise.faqs.3.question: Is my photo uploaded anywhere?
tools.image-denoise.faqs.3.answer: No. All processing happens locally in your browser — your photos never leave your device.

tools.image-denoise.guide.whatIs.body.1: A median filter removes noise while preserving edges and detail better than most approaches, making it a common denoising technique in photo editing.

tools.image-deblur.metadata.title: Image Deblur - Sharpen Blurry Photos Online
tools.image-deblur.metadata.description: Free online tool to sharpen blurry photos and restore crisp detail with adjustable Laplacian sharpening. Processed entirely in your browser.
tools.image-deblur.title: Image Deblur
tools.image-deblur.description: Sharpen blurry or out-of-focus photos and restore detail and outlines. The tool uses Laplacian sharpening convolution with multiple iterations to make mildly blurred photos crisp again. All processing happens locally in your browser.
tools.image-deblur.faqs.0.question: How does deblurring work?
tools.image-deblur.faqs.0.answer: The tool uses Laplacian sharpening convolution: it detects edges (high-frequency detail) in the image and re-adds that detail on top of the image. Multiple iterations gradually enhance clarity.
tools.image-deblur.faqs.1.question: Can it fix severely blurred photos?
tools.image-deblur.faqs.1.answer: It works well for mild to moderate blur and out-of-focus shots, but detail lost in heavily blurred photos cannot be recovered out of thin air. Start with a low strength to avoid halos and noise.
tools.image-deblur.faqs.2.question: How should I set the parameters?
tools.image-deblur.faqs.2.answer: Strength controls how much sharpening is applied per iteration (20–50% is recommended), and iterations controls how many rounds are applied (1–3 is recommended). Too much strength produces a halo effect.
tools.image-deblur.faqs.3.question: Is my photo uploaded anywhere?
tools.image-deblur.faqs.3.answer: No. All processing happens locally in your browser — your photos never leave your device.
